description.zh: 业务背景，描述任务的原因或目标，以减少沟通成本。
description.en: The purpose or objective of the SQL review. This reduces unnecessary communication.

description.zh: 相关人列表。设置的相关人可查看工单，并协同工作，非相关人员不能查看工单（管理员、DBA除外）。
description.en: The stakeholders involved in this operation. All the specified stakeholders can view the ticket details and take part in the approval process. Irrelevant users other than DMS administrators and database administrators (DBAs) are not allowed to view the ticket details.

description.zh: 租户ID。您可以调用[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.

descriptions.zh:
仅管控模式为安全协同的数据库实例可调用此API。

关于该功能的更多说明，请参见[SQL审核](~~60374~~)。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation only for database instances that are managed in Security Collaboration mode.

For more information about the SQL review feature, see [SQL review](~~60374~~).
